match.userMessage: Which stage of the Sales pipeline has the most open opportunities, and what are they worth in total?

toolCalls.name: query_data
toolCalls.arguments: {"sources": [{"as": "o", "operation": "opportunities.search-opportunity", "params": {"query": {"pipeline_id": "fake-pipeline-sales", "status": "open"}}, "rowsField": "opportunities"}, {"as": "p", "operation": "opportunities.get-pipelines", "rowsField": "pipelines"}], "sql": "SELECT o.pipelineStageId, json_extract(s.value,'$.name') AS stage, COUNT(*) n, SUM(o.monetaryValue) total, SUM(o.monetaryValue IS NULL) nulls, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.status) statuses FROM o LEFT JOIN p ON p.id=o.pipelineId LEFT JOIN json_each(p.stages) s ON json_extract(s.value,'$.id')=o.pipelineStageId WHERE o.status='open' AND o.pipelineId='fake-pipeline-sales' GROUP BY o.pipelineStageId ORDER BY n DESC"}
